page_title: VAL 1-2 BET | Valencia v Betis 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+6' Valencia control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+5' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Sergi Canos (Valencia) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
90+2' Hugo Duro (Valencia) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
90+1' The referee blows his whistle, Valencia are awarded a corner kick.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Ayoze Perez and he is replaced by Abner (Betis).
89' The substitution has been made. William Carvalho (Betis) has replaced Johnny Cardoso.
88' Rui Silva (Betis) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
87' The game is interrupted now, Rui Silva (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
86' Pepelu (Valencia) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
85' Pepelu (Valencia) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
85' One of the Valencia players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
84' Substitution. Diego Lopez is replaced by Alberto Mari (Valencia).
81' Pepelu (Valencia) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the right side of the target, but Rui Silva easily deals with the threat.
77' Yellow card! It's like Sergi Canos (Valencia) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Mateo Busquets Ferrer agrees and books him.

77' 1 - 2 Goal! Ayoze Perez (Betis) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the bottom left corner. Giorgi Mamardashvili had no chance of reaching it. The score is 1:2.
77' The attendance is 46371.
76' Today's match ends for Cedric Bakambu who will be replaced by Willian Jose (Betis).
73' Peter Gonzalez (Valencia) hits an explosive shot from outside the penalty area and forces the goalkeeper to make a good save.
72' The current number of shots on goal is 2:4.
67' Ruben Baraja has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hugo Guillamon (Valencia) replacing Andre Almeida.
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) comes onto the pitch so that Thierry Correia can be given a rest.
66' 1 - 1 Goal! Pepelu (Valencia) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Rui Silva into the bottom left corner.
66' Pepelu (Valencia) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
64' The main referee, Mateo Busquets Ferrer, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) is given a yellow card for dissent.
64' Juan Miranda (Betis) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
64' Juan Miranda (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows his whistle for an infringement. Valencia are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
64' Here is a change. Javi Guerra is going off and Ruben Baraja gives the last tactical orders to Peter Gonzalez (Valencia).
63' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Valencia will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
63' Valencia have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
62' Cedric Bakambu (Betis) has a goal ruled out for offside!
62' Pablo Fornals (Betis) blows a great chance. He unleashes a shot from inside the box, but the effort rattles the left post. The goalkeeper can remain calm.
61' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Betis.
59' Here's the change. Isco leaves the pitch and Nabil Fekir (Betis) comes on as a substitute.
57' The game is interrupted as Diego Lopez (Valencia) is flagged offside.
54' Diego Lopez (Valencia) commits a foul and Mateo Busquets Ferrer immediately signals a free kick.
52' Isco (Betis) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
52' Isco (Betis) whips in a cross from the corner, but Giorgi Mamardashvili is well positioned and punches the ball away.

52' What a great chance for German Pezzella (Betis). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header towards the foot of the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
51' Isco (Betis) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
51' A poorly taken free kick by Isco (Betis)! He sends a shot from the edge of the box into the defensive wall.
50' A free kick on the edge of the box for Betis. Let's see if they'll manage to convert it into a goal.
49' Thierry Correia (Valencia) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
46' We are about to witness a subsitution. Sergi Canos (Valencia) for Fran Perez.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
44' The resulting corner from Isco (Betis) is cleared by the defence.
43' Pepelu (Valencia) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
41' The shots on goal statistics – 1:3.
38' Flag up against Pablo Fornals (Betis). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
34' Isco (Betis) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the left post.
33' Isco (Betis) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
30' Thierry Correia (Valencia) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
29' Thierry Correia (Valencia) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
28' German Pezzella (Betis) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the right side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
28' Isco (Betis) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

26' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Mateo Busquets Ferrer blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
23' Pepelu (Valencia) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Jesus Vazquez darts into free space to control the ball.
19' 0 - 1 Goal! Isco plays a pass to the feet of Ayoze Perez (Betis), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 0:1.
17' Ayoze Perez (Betis) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
16' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
13' What was Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
10' Cenk Ozkacar (Valencia) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets underneath the ball and it flies high over the bar.
9' Pepelu (Valencia) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
9' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Pepelu (Valencia).
8' A cross into the box from Thierry Correia (Valencia) is cleared.
6' Isco (Betis) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
4' Valencia are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
